description: Self-issue an AllRatesToday API key with 100 lifetime calls, valid 7 days, with no account and no email. Use it when another tool answered "needs an API key" and the user wants real-time rates or history right now. The key is adopted by this server for the rest of the session and returned once — tell the user to put it in the MCP config as ALLRATES_API_KEY to keep it. Capped at 3 keys per IP per day. For a lasting key, register at https://allratestoday.com/register (free, 300 calls) or see https://allratestoday.com/pricing.

agent.description: Optional: the agent or product requesting the key.

purpose.description: Optional: one line on what the rates are for.

adopted.description: True when this server switched to the new key
